nodes.name: Chemical reduction and annealing
nodes.procedure: Mo-NiO/Ni (MNN) nanocomposites were synthesized by chemical reduction and annealing in the N2 atmosphere. Four representative samples were synthesized with different Mo levels, specifically M0/(M0+Ni) of 4%, 8%, 16% and 20% at the precursor stage, which were denoted as MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 and 4), respectively.
nodes.source_text: Mo-NiO/Ni (MNN) nanocomposites were synthesized by chemical reduction and annealing in the N2 atmosphere.

nodes.name: Synthesis of reference Ni nanoparticles
nodes.procedure: Ni nanoparticles (NPs) were synthesized as reference samples.
nodes.source_text: In addition, three reference samples were also synthesized: Ni nanoparticles (NPs), c-Mo-NiO and c-Mo-NiO/Ni

nodes.name: Synthesis of crystalline reference samples
nodes.procedure: Three reference samples were also synthesized: Ni nanoparticles (NPs), c-Mo-NiO and c-Mo-NiO/Ni (where 'c' represents that NiO is crystalline in nanocomposites).
nodes.source_text: In addition, three reference samples were also synthesized: Ni nanoparticles (NPs), c-Mo-NiO and c-Mo-NiO/Ni (where “c” represents that NiO is crystalline in nanocomposites, Figure S2).

nodes.description: HER performance in 1 M KOH on GCE
nodes.source_text: The η₁₀ for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 and 4) are 118, 76, 50 and 352 mV, respectively (Figure 5A). The Tafel slopes derived from polarization curves (Figure 5B) are 153, 110, 86 and 170 mV dec⁻¹ for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 and 4), respectively. The electron transfer resistances (R_ct) for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3) are 12.5, 8.95 and 5.95 Ω, respectively, indicating an efficient electron kinetic during HER process. Nyquist plots were collected at -0.2 V vs. RHE (Figure 5C).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show MNN samples consist of agglomerated nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images (Figure S3) show that the samples consist of agglomerated NPs...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM reveals MNN nanoparticle sizes ~40-100 nm; Ni region decreases and amorphous oxide layer thickens from MNN-1 to MNN-4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images (Figure S4) show that the size of the NPs are ~ 40-100 nm. The TEM images also reveal that from MNN-1 to MNN-4... the Ni region gradually becomes smaller while the amorphous layer becomes thicker

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of MNN-x show peaks at 44.5°, 51.8°, 76.4° for fcc Ni (111), (200), (220) planes; additional NiO peaks at 37.2° and 62.9° (111), (220) only in MNN-4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the MNN-x samples (Figure 2B and S5) show three peaks located at 44.5, 51.8 and 76.4°, which correspond to the (111), (200) and (220) planes of fcc Ni...

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern of MNN-3 shows one set of diffraction rings attributed to (111), (200), (220), (311), (331) planes of polycrystalline fcc Ni.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Only one set of diffraction rings can be observed in a selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern of MNN-3 (Figure 2C), which are attributed to the (111), (200), (220), (311) and (331) planes of fcc Ni...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows Mo-NiO/Ni structure with crystalline Ni(111) planes (FFT bright spots) and amorphous Mo-NiO region (no FFT spots); grain boundaries present.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High resolution TEM (HRTEM) images of the Mo-NiO/Ni structure are shown from a side view in Figure 3B... No bright spot is observed in the Mo-NiO region, indicating its amorphous nature.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM with EDS mapping shows Mo concentrated in the outer amorphous layer of particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To further determine the relative distributions of Ni and Mo in the nanocomposite, high-angle annular dark field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) was conducted... Mo is more concentrated in the outer amorphous layer of the particles...

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS elemental mapping of MNN-3 shows presence of Ni, Mo, and O, indicating coexistence of Ni and Mo-NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS elemental mapping of MNN-3 shows the presence of Ni, Mo and O (Figure S7), indicating the coexistence of Ni and Mo-NiO in this sample.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p: Ni⁰ (852.5 eV, 35.7→10.6% MNN-1→4), Ni²⁺ (855.8 eV, BE shift in MNN-3); Mo 3d: Mo⁴⁺(229.2), Mo⁵⁺(230.4), Mo⁶⁺(232.2 eV), avg valence 5.18→5.58; O 1s: defect O (531.4 eV strong), lattice M-O (529.9 eV stronger in MNN-4).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure 4A, the high resolution XPS data in the Ni 2p region has two peaks... at 852.5 and 855.8 eV were assigned to Ni⁰ and Ni²⁺... The Mo 3d XPS spectra in Figure 4B could be fitted... corresponding to Mo4+, Mo5+ and Mo6+... In the O 1s XPS spectra... O defects (531.4 eV)... oxygen in the lattice (529.9 eV, denoted as M-O)

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES of MNN-3 close to Ni NPs (edge shoulder ~8336 eV) with features between Ni and NiO, confirming metallic Ni main phase with NiO presence; Mo K-edge shows Mo mainly Mo⁶⁺ in c-Mo-NiO, lower valence in MNN-3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni K-edge XANES spectrum for MNN-3 (rising edge shoulder at 8333 eV) is close to that of Ni NPs... indicating the existence of NiO in MNN-3.

properties.description: Transmission Electron Microscopy image showing purple-colored nanoparticles with irregular morphology

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge k³-weighted EXAFS shows Ni-Ni coordination at 2.17 Å (fcc Ni) and 2.56 Å (NiO); MNN-3 shows decreased Ni-Ni shell intensity vs Ni reference indicating lower coordination and defects; c-Mo-NiO Ni-O at 1.662 Å (vs 1.673 Å in NiO).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The radial distribution function from the Ni K-edge k³-weighted extended X-ray adsorption fine structure (EXAFS) is shown in Figure 4E... The decrease in magnitude of Ni-Ni coordination shell intensity of MNN-3 relative to the Ni reference suggests a lower coordination number...
